subject: Vendor intake: invoice-only route for research grant suppliers — governance & signoff
messages:
From: Dr. Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@grantlab.org>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: GrantLab Contracts <contracts@grantlab.org>
Date: Sat, 13 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier onboarding for small research stipends — invoice-only ask

Hi Evelyn,

We run small research awards and need to add a couple of university labs as suppliers to pay stipends and equipment reimbursements (typical invoices <$2k monthly). Our procurement office requires a W9 and SOW but cannot issue POs for these grant-funded awards due to university accounting rules.

Would Redwood consider a temporary "invoice-only" onboarding path for GrantLab-funded suppliers with the following guardrails: W9 on file, SOW, monthly invoice cap of $2k, and quarterly evidence check? We're looking for a short-term solution for a six-month pilot.

Attached: GrantLab_W9.pdf, SOW-research-pilot.docx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call.

— Priya
Dr. Priya Suresh
Director, Research Partnerships
GrantLab

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Feb 2027 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Supplier onboarding for small research stipends — invoice-only ask

Forwarding — GrantLab (external) is asking for an invoice-only onboarding band for university labs tied to grants. They provided W9 + SOW. Key constraints: small monthly invoices, SOW defined, and preference for a 6-month pilot.

Quick context: Procurement policy defaults to PO-required for suppliers, but we do allow temporary invoice-only routes for certain low-risk cases (consultants, one-off contractors). This seems similar but touches university accounting (no PO issuance).

Ask: Can procurement/finance sign off on a temporary, evidence-led exemption with a single-approver path? If so, what evidence and controls do you need (limits, duration, sampling)?

Thanks — Evelyn

Date: Sat, 13 Feb 2027 14:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Supplier onboarding for small research stipends — invoice-only ask

Thanks for sharing, Evelyn. I like the proposal — low ticket sizes and grant-backed documentation reduce risk. Proposal for an internal approval flow: 

- Eligibility checklist (to be stored in vendor record): W9, signed SOW, institution contact, payment schedule.
- Limits: invoice cap $2,000 per month, aggregated cap $6,000 per quarter. Any invoice exceeding cap escalates to PO path.
- Duration: pilot length 6 months; auto-expire with calendar notification.
- Evidence sampling: finance to sample 10% of invoices each month; procurement will do a quarterly file review.
- Single approver: Procurement manager + Finance reviewer (email signoff) — documented in the vendor note.

Questions for Sergio / David: do we need an additional legal signoff or an amended clause in the standard terms? Also, can we add a DocuSign link for the SOW acceptance and a HubSpot tag to track pilot vendors?

I can draft the short approval memo for signatures if you confirm the reviewers.

— Marissa
Product Ops Lead, GTM
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: GrantLab Contracts <contracts@grantlab.org>, Dr. Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@grantlab.org>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding for small research stipends — invoice-only ask

Hi Priya / Contracts team,

Thanks for the clarity and for the attachments. Procurement and finance have tentatively approved a 6-month pilot under the controls Marissa outlined: W9 on file, signed SOW via DocuSign, $2k monthly cap, quarterly evidence checks, and 10% invoice sampling by finance. We'll add a HubSpot pipeline tag "invoice-only-pilot" and flag the vendor record.

Next steps for GrantLab:
- Please countersign the attached SOW via DocuSign (I will send the link in a separate email).
- Confirm the invoice cadence and the payee details exactly as they should appear on the invoice.
- If any single invoice will exceed $2k, notify us in advance so we can route for PO issuance.

I'll treat this as a conditional approval; final activation happens once we receive the signed SOW and have the W9 loaded into vendor onboarding. Expect the DocuSign in the next 2 hours.

Best,
David Kim
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: GrantLab_W9.pdf, SOW-research-pilot.docx
